# PDF upload

> Accepts an uploaded file, verifies it is a well-formed PDF, and returns the validated PDF.

- **System:** [pdf-upload](../index.md#pdf-upload)
- **Caller:** External — the caller is outside the trust boundary
- **Blast radius:** Medium
- **Source:** [`pdf_upload.yamlet.yaml`](../../../../../specs_example/pdf_upload.yamlet.yaml)

A user-facing upload surface that receives a single file, checks it really is a well-formed PDF within size limits, and hands the validated PDF back to the caller. It stores nothing — persistence is a separate concern for another component.

## Contract

`pdf-upload` — accept a file, verify it is a well-formed PDF, and return either the validated PDF or a rejection error

- **Inputs:** `file`, `filename`
- **Outputs:** `pdf_file`, `error`

## Requirements

<a id="rq-1"></a>

### RQ-1 · The service accepts a valid upload and returns the validated PDF

<a id="ac-1"></a>
**AC-1** · When `file` named `filename` is uploaded, the system shall:

- verify `file` is a well-formed PDF of at most 10 MiB
- return `pdf_file` to the caller
- preserve `filename` as the name of the returned PDF

<a id="rq-2"></a>

### RQ-2 · The service rejects untrusted or malformed uploads

<a id="ac-2"></a>
**AC-2** · If `file` is not a well-formed PDF, then the system shall:

- reject the upload
- return `error` describing why `file` is not a well-formed PDF
- return no `pdf_file`

<a id="ac-3"></a>
**AC-3** · If `file` exceeds 10 MiB, then the system shall:

- reject the upload
- return `error` stating `file` exceeds the size limit
- return no `pdf_file`

- [PDF e-mail archiver](../pdf-archiver/pdf_archiver.md) as `uploads`
- [Resilient PDF e-mail archiver](../pdf-archiver/pdf_archiver_resilient.md) as `uploads`
